scope: Single-request single-token BF16 FFN producer-consumer dataflow; no batching
status: All three retained streaming variants pass stage oracle and 128-step bitwise model regression; performance evaluation continues for block-cyclic variant
precision: Original BF16 GEMV operands and FP32 accumulation, activation/residual/norm. WKV state stays FP32. Per-output K tile order stays 0..31; no reassociation, approximation, fast-math or activation precision change.
device: RyzenAI-npu6, XDNA2 eight columns, default power mode; same model/toolchain as spatial-w2-eight report

variants.stream: Four W1 produce 256 outputs at a time. Two pair collectors and one root collector serialize canonical channel order. Four W2 consume a 256-element FIFO; row-major weights are read K-major using strided DMA. Fourteen compute workers.
variants.packed: Same graph, W2 tiles repacked once on host at model load to [worker=4,K/256,local_row/16,16,256], allowing contiguous replay DMA. No decode-time weight packing or additional host transfers.
variants.interleaved: W1 worker j owns 256-output blocks j,j+4,...; W1 DMA selects these from unchanged canonical key weights. MemTile joins four 256-output blocks into each successive contiguous 1024-element activation chunk. W2 consumes eight chunks with four K tiles per chunk, in original per-row reduction order. Raw diagnostic DMA scatters worker-local rows back into canonical order. No collectors; eleven compute workers, same count as production.

collector_model_comparison.order: A/S/P/P/S/A; 8 prompt, 48 decode, 2 trials, 4 warmup; no compilation overlap
collector_model_comparison.decision: Reject both 3-collector graphs for production; ~205.85/203.82 vs ~198.73 ms/token.

interleaved_first_capture.scope: Marked execution on selected cores; excludes waiting for initial activation. Fractions overlap; vector issue is not peak-compute utilization.

trace.scope: Only key0/value0. W1 includes activation production/backpressure; W2 begins after first activation and includes later chunk waits. Different regions/data dependencies from monolithic production, so lock fraction changes are not a utilization comparison. No whole-array compute/DMA utilization claim.
trace.diagnostic_fix: Direct MLIR event markers produced incomplete W2 windows (end before begin); moving the source marker behind acquire did not fix it. Out-of-line diagnostic C++ event calls gave complete windows. Initial incomplete traces are excluded, not repaired in the analyzer.

production_default: Untouched; all builds require isolated roots and refuse the default production directory.
limits: K-major experimental weights support sequential decode/prefill only; batch2/chunk4 rejects them before dispatch.
Spatial INT8 variants are not introduced. Existing W8A16 path remains unchanged.
This is an FFN subgraph prototype, not an integrated 32-tile full-layer graph or a measured hardware ceiling.
